newsitem.title: UK: Russia's energy minister to visit Iraq next week.
newsitem.headline: Russia's energy minister to visit Iraq next week.

text.p: Russian energy minister Pyotr Rodionov will visit Iraq next week despite President Yeltsin's recent government reshuffle, deputy minister of fuel and energy Viktor Ott told a press conference here on Thursday.
"Indeed, a trip will happen. It will be of the Russian part of the Russian-Iraqi inter-governmental trade commission under Rodionov," said Ott.
Ott said Russian oil executives accompanying the minister were hoping to sign contracts to develop Iraq's massive upstream potential, once United Nations sanctions are lifted.
"Russian oil companies have done a lot to make sure they can sign contracts so they can take part in oil developments in Iraq," he said.

Alexander Putilov, president of state oil holding company Rosneft, said that Rosneft will complete its current contract with Iraq's State Oil Marketing Organisation (SOMO) under the U.N.'s oil-for-food accord implemented last December by lifting a final shipment on April 15.
